releases.name: Murmuring of Moth Mouth
releases.summary: The newest Car Racing takes you out from all the losers.Brand-new fancy cars to choose.

releases.name: Mad Mads Madsen
releases.summary: At his lowest Mads gained it all. Finally feeling victorious, he quickly found out that old habits and pre-given conditions can not be rid of. Help Mads survive and find out yourself why this is happening to him.

releases.name: Proper Tosser
releases.summary: Proper Tosser is an incremental physics game where you toss boxes properly. Become a Proper Tosser by purchasing upgrades and tossing farther each time. Do you have what it takes to be a Proper Tosser?

releases.name: Cursed District: Horror
releases.summary:
An old factory district has stood silent for decades after a series of unexplained disappearances forced everyone to leave. Locals say the entire area is cursed, bound by ancient voodoo relics hidden throughout the abandoned buildings.

Determined to end the nightmare, you enter the district with one goal: find every cursed relic and break the curse once and for all. But as you search through abandoned factories, rusting warehouses, dark alleyways, and forgotten offices, you realize something else still calls this place home..

releases.name: Hentai Tales: The Plumber
releases.summary: As a specialized plumbing technician in Kyoto, I thought my job was just fixing pipes in old townhouses. But at "Sakura Moon Villa," two elegant women hide desperate cravings beneath their refined surfaces.

releases.name: Sad Virus Ruined Land
releases.summary: World in Numbers takes you on an exciting trip through five continents of the world (Asia, Africa, Europe, Americas and Australia), but this trip is not like any trip you've taken before.With 50 brain teasing stages in 50 different countries:- Test your eyes sharpness and abilities in matching between numbers.- Find out how it will do when you are playing against time.- Put your memory to the ultimate test.- Test your abilities in solving mathematical formulas.- Play against your own device and find out how you will do against it.19 different achievements are waiting for you to collect them, if you believe you are good enough enjoy our trophies and be proud of your brain.Multiplayer:Nothing more challenging and exciting like sharing your skills with other players, if you're up to the challenge profit to friends by trying our:Split Screen (for iPad).You can also challenge your friends via Bluetooth.We believe our new brain teasing game concept will give you the brain stimulation you have ever had.Don’t forget to check out your brain ranking on Earth from Game Center.

releases.name: Escape From Lab
releases.summary: Use cutting-edge laboratory equipment to solve challenging puzzles and escape from a black laboratory. A high-difficulty puzzle game that rewards logical thinking and careful deduction.

releases.name: Basketball Legacy Manager 27
releases.summary: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional basketball team!

releases.name: Kilnborn
releases.summary: Test your platform fighting-game fundamentals in Kilnborn, a fast-paced platform fighting game where you die in one hit. Kilnborn's pottery protagonists may be fragile, but all play differently with depth to discover in every match.

releases.name: ClearIt M4
releases.summary: Test your aim and puzzle-solving skills! Shoot colorful balls, match them by color, trigger chain reactions and overcome unique obstacles. Explore challenging levels, use powerful special elements and compete against the computer!

releases.name: Liquid Cats
releases.summary: 3D + Physics + Shooting ! Probably the most innovative and interesting mobile game you will ever played !Join the cubot force to defeat incoming invaders ! Cubot is an exciting shooting game with amazing 3D environment. Beautiful 3D graphics and lighting effects with innovative physic factors make the game very interesting. Your goal is to control Cubot to defeat enemies with fire power. Avoid enemies' fire and unkillable resistant with your movement and jumping. Cubot will power up her status with leveling and level is rise by gaining experiences from defeating enemies and completing stages.Features? Innovative and exciting gameplay style? 3D environment with dynamic physic engine ? Stunning graphic and lighting effects? Over 90 levels for you to achieves? Over 30 Stages for your challenge? Many elite enemies are waiting for your challenge? Large variation of enemies and AIs? Power up Cubot status with leveling? Level up your Cubot by gaining experience from defeating enemies? Each level gain specific status enhancement to help you defeat enemy more efficiency ? Cubot able to jump to avoid unkillable resistants? Cubot's special weapon able to defeat tough enemies? We will continue to improve the gameplay and keep adding more interesting elementsThe power of Cubot is the key to conquer the stage. When you face a tough enemy that you cannot defeat. It's better to go back to previous stage to gain enough experience to power up Cubot and challenge again.We will continue to improve the gameplay by adding more stages with various gameplay, designing more enemies with difference attitudes and AIs, create more elite enemies with special power and unique skills. Enhance the graphic and models quality.Our goal is to create a very innovative and interesting game that everyone enjoys to play it. The value is far more than the price and you will not regret to have Cubot in you mobile.

releases.name: Post Office: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: Discover the world of playing games with words! Play with your friends or anyone else on the internet. Choose between three languages in the game, challenge up to four teammates and practice your foreign languages.For every round in a game, a player is given up to seven tiles, which he or she can attach to existing words on the board. Besides letters, the tiles also have a value which differs depending on the chosen language and how common the letter is. You can maximize your score by placing tiles on the special fields on the board.This is the perfect game to be played during the normal course of life. Thanks to the turn-based play, every player has enough time to consider his or her perfect move and the game can last days, weeks or even months. A fun and exciting gaming experience that won't monopolize all of your free time!

releases.name: Moon Garden
releases.summary:
A cozy incremental game about growing your way home.

Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!
